LanguageData.RR_Personnel_BranchUnavailable: A supported company branch is required. Applicant records and held people remain preserved.
LanguageData.RR_Personnel_UnsupportedSchema: This personnel save uses an unsupported schema. Keep the original save and use its matching build; do not overwrite it.
LanguageData.RR_Personnel_InvalidSave: Personnel identities or custody records could not be reconciled. Actions are disabled; preserve this save and review the log.
LanguageData.RR_Personnel_InvalidOffer: This applicant or its saved quote is unavailable.
LanguageData.RR_Personnel_PawnUnavailable: This employee is unavailable for a role change. Check their location, faction, health and custody.
LanguageData.RR_Personnel_RegistrationBlocked: This person must be alive, free, player-owned and physically at headquarters before employment can be registered. Their existing identity is retained.
LanguageData.RR_Personnel_Busy: A personnel operation is already in progress.
LanguageData.RR_Personnel_RequestCooldown: The applicant request interval has not elapsed. Keep or resolve the existing offers.
LanguageData.RR_Personnel_FinishOffers: Resolve the current offers, releases and held-person recovery before requesting another group.
LanguageData.RR_Personnel_FinishHire: Finish or recover the pending hire/release before accepting another person.
LanguageData.RR_Personnel_PolicyMissing: The ordinary applicant policy is missing or invalid. Check the installed Rimrooms package; no substitute quote was generated.
LanguageData.RR_Personnel_MapUnavailable: The original company headquarters is not available as a loaded player home map. No new map or replacement arrival was created.
LanguageData.RR_Personnel_GenerationFailed: This applicant attempt failed native generation or validation. A returned person is preserved for release; no replacement is rerolled automatically.
LanguageData.RR_Personnel_CustodyChanged: The saved applicant is no longer in the expected custody, faction or location. Locate the original person and restore the recorded route; no replacement is created.
LanguageData.RR_Personnel_CustodyUnconfirmed: The original person is still held here or is detached with custody unconfirmed. The record remains open and blocks another applicant group. Locate or restore custody first; dismissing never transfers or releases a person.
LanguageData.RR_Personnel_CannotRelease: This person cannot be released from the applicant board while a charge, arrival or recruitment is unresolved.
LanguageData.RR_Personnel_PawnMissing: The original person is missing, dead or destroyed. Their identity and payment history are retained; no substitute person or automatic refund is created.
LanguageData.RR_Personnel_ReleaseInterrupted: Applicant release was interrupted. The original person and release receipt are retained; use Retry release after resolving custody.
LanguageData.RR_Personnel_OfferClosed: This offer is expired, accepted or closed. Its original terms cannot be reused for another hire.
LanguageData.RR_Personnel_ArrivalBlocked: No clear, unfogged and colony-reachable headquarters edge cell is available for this person. Clear an ordinary map entrance and retry.
LanguageData.RR_Personnel_ArrivalInterrupted: Arrival was interrupted. The same person's map/holder state and payment receipt are retained. Retry does not charge or generate a second person.
LanguageData.RR_Personnel_RecruitInterrupted: Native recruitment did not complete its required pawn/work state. The person remains at their actual location; keep the save and inspect the native/mod error before retrying.
LanguageData.RR_Personnel_HireInterrupted: Hiring was interrupted. Inspect the original person's custody and the log, then retry this receipt. No second onboarding payment is required.
LanguageData.RR_Personnel_CannotCancel: Cancellation needs the original off-site applicant in our holder, with no actual arrival, recruitment or employee registration. A failed spawn must first be reconciled off-site. Arrived or ambiguous people cannot be refunded.
LanguageData.RR_Personnel_NativeExplanation: Company roles describe assignments. Native skills, needs, health, beds, work priorities and schedules still control daily life.
LanguageData.RR_Personnel_HeldCount: People retained in the personnel recovery holder: {0}
LanguageData.RR_Personnel_BoardExplanation: Request up to {0} ordinary applicants every {1} game days. Inspect the actual person and equipment before accepting. Unaccepted candidates remain off-site; the board provides no free staff, work or supplies.
LanguageData.RR_Personnel_RequestAt: Next applicant request: day {0} or later, after open offers are resolved.
LanguageData.RR_Personnel_Quote: One-time onboarding: ${0} USD. Daily wage: ${1} USD, billed separately.
LanguageData.RR_Personnel_HireProgress: Onboarding charged: {0}. Arrival attempted: {1}. Employment registered: {2}.
LanguageData.RR_Personnel_CancelHire: Cancel before arrival and refund any onboarding charge
LanguageData.RR_Personnel_UnavailableDisposition: Dismissal only drops this board's reference after the original person is confirmed spawned, world-owned, held elsewhere, destroyed or discarded. The person is never moved or released.
LanguageData.RR_Personnel_DismissUnavailable: Dismiss record only; leave person untouched
LanguageData.RR_Personnel_Archived: {0} older closed applicant summaries compacted. Company staff and ledger receipts remain available; closed IDs cannot create new hires.
LanguageData.RR_Personnel_Custody: In custody; ordinary custody controls apply.
LanguageData.RR_Personnel_MentalState: In a mental state; native needs and recovery apply.
LanguageData.RR_Personnel_OnMap: Physically present on a loaded map.
LanguageData.RR_Personnel_OffMap: Off-map; inspect the person's saved location/custody.
LanguageData.RR_Personnel_NeedsUnavailable: Native needs are unavailable for this person.
LanguageData.RR_Personnel_OffsiteNote: Off-site applicants retain their offered native profile. Arrival enables ordinary colony work, needs and care; no need or skill is reset by this report.
LanguageData.RR_Personnel_Work: Native work availability and current priority
LanguageData.RR_Personnel_WorkAvailable: {0}: available; native priorities initialize on recruitment
LanguageData.RR_Personnel_PayrollTerms: After arrival and registration, the first full daily wage is due at the next headquarters payroll boundary (currently day {0}). Later days use the existing company payroll.
LanguageData.RR_Personnel_PayrollLimit: The game tick limit has no representable future payroll boundary. Daily wages remain governed by company payroll; this quote cannot display a future date.
LanguageData.RR_Personnel_ArrivalTerms: The same inspected person arrives at a clear headquarters map edge and joins through native recruitment. Their listed equipment comes with them. You provide beds, food, care and assignments. Cancellation/refund requires confirmed off-site custody before actual arrival or recruitment.
LanguageData.RR_Personnel_RoleTerms: The selected role does not change skills, traits, schedules or work priorities. Set native work priorities yourself.
